findings.text: issue (blocking): `TemporaryDirectory(delete=...)` was introduced in Python 3.12, but `.github/workflows/loom-code-ci.yml` runs loom-code under Python 3.11; every non-help invocation will raise `TypeError` before cloning.
findings.fix: Implement keep/cleanup using the Python 3.11-compatible `TemporaryDirectory` API and add a test executed under Python 3.11.

findings.text: issue (blocking): The probe never asserts `result.returncode == 0`, so collection errors, interpreter failures, or no-tests-collected exits can produce no `FAILED` lines and falsely satisfy the permanent regression check.
findings.fix: Assert a zero subprocess return code and include stdout and stderr in the failure message before inspecting skip reasons.

findings.text: issue: The report names complete terminal output as evidence, but supplies neither the commands and output nor an artifact path, leaving its pass and skip claims unreproducible.
findings.fix: Embed the exact commands and relevant output or link each claim to a committed evidence artifact containing them.

findings.text: issue: The conclusion says Acceptance 1 is complete even though the command was exercised only with Python 3.12 and fails on the declared Python 3.11 CI runtime.
findings.fix: Re-run the repaired command under Python 3.11 and revise the conclusion and evidence to include that result.

findings.text: nitpick: This internal artifact is written in Traditional Chinese, while the repository's language policy requires internal delta artifacts to be English.
